text:
anya-sec: Auditor SG asked for a tight evidence package for scoped SOC2 fieldwork: RBAC change for service account `svc-embedder`, the API/gateway traces that show the change was applied, KMS usage metadata (no plaintext), and proof of custody for the exported bundle. they want it by COB.

lee-dev: ok. which timeframe? the PR merged yesterday at 2026-03-19T09:05Z. do they want a full 48h window or just PR+12h?

anya-sec: request was PR merge time + 12h. include PR diff, deployment job logs, and the canary rollout notes. keep it minimal.

rachel-ml: note: this change scoped a new permission in the embedder namespace so it can refresh ephemeral model keys: added `secrets/get` on `namespaces/embedder/secrets/model-keys`. OPA scan ran and returned "no policy violations".

oncall-bot: FYI detailed gateway traces retained for 60 days; debug payloads are sampled. recommend exporting exact window to archive s3 and providing checksums.

lee-dev: starting export. @ops-bot please export k8s-audit, authz-events, api-gateway logs, and CloudTrail KMS events for the key arn: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333:key/abc-embedder-key from 2026-03-19T09:05:00Z to 2026-03-19T21:05:00Z to `s3://redwood-audit/7800024680-evidence/`. include request IDs.

ops-bot: export initiated job-id=exp-7800024680-01. estimated 6m. will post presigned link and sha256.

anya-sec: auditor_sg wants a signed manifest (soc HMAC) plus per-file sha256. also include a short chain-of-custody note and the evidence id we use internally.

auditor_sg: that works. please include: 1) the RBAC patch (git PR link + diff), 2) the access-logs showing the RBAC evaluation that switched allow for svc-embedder, 3) KMS CloudTrail events (Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey) for the key, 4) object hashes + manifest signature. hashes/hmac accepted.

rachel-ml: added context: no GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext calls were used by svc-embedder — only GenerateDataKey (envelope) and Decrypt calls; plaintext never left KMS. we can include the CloudTrail parameters showing ciphertextBlob usage, not plaintext.

ops-bot: export ready: https://s3-presigned.redwood/audit/7800024680-evidence.tar.gz?sig=YYY (expires in 7d). sha256: a1f4b2...9d00.

anya-sec: manifest signed: MANIFEST_SHA256=a1f4b2...9d00 ; SIG_MANIFEST=MEYCIQCb...; signed-by=anya-sec (SOC HMAC). internal evidence tag: EVID-20260319-7800024680. chain-of-custody note attached.

lee-dev: RBAC diff snippet for reference:

```diff
- rolebinding embedder-reader -> group: embedder-viewers
+ rolebinding embedder-reader -> group: embedder-operators
+ rules:
+ - apiGroups: [""]
+   resources: ["secrets"]
+   verbs: ["get"]
+   resourceNames: ["model-keys"]
```

rachel-ml: added unit test and OPA query results: `data.authz.deny == []` for the new policy bundle. attaching small audit log excerpt that shows `svc-embedder` requests were allowed after 2026-03-19T09:06:30Z.

auditor_sg: please confirm: do you have anomaly detection on the KMS key that alerts on high-rate Decrypt/GenerateDataKey ops? would like to see the alert history for the window.

anya-sec: yes  our detection rule is `KMS-UNUSUAL-OP-RATE-v1` and it forwards to PagerDuty. no alerts during the requested window. we'll include the rule definition and last 30d firing log (none in window).

ops-bot: included CloudTrail fragments: events with EventName=Decrypt / GenerateDataKey / Encrypt, and RequestParameters.keyId fields; userIdentity.arn redacted for internal ops tools.

lee-dev: reproducibility commands for auditor: 

```bash
curl -s -o evidence.tar.gz "https://s3-presigned.redwood/audit/7800024680-evidence.tar.gz?sig=YYY"
sha256sum evidence.tar.gz
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify soc_pub.pem -signature manifest.sig manifest.json
```

anya-sec: sending secure link and manifest to auditor_sg now. if they ask for raw logs we can escalate and provide unredacted CloudTrail under an NDA channel.

auditor_sg: received the bundle and manifest, hash verified. may follow up with one sample query on CloudTrail event detail but for now this suffices. thanks for the fast response.

anya-sec: thanks team — closing after auditor confirms final acceptance. tag any follow-ups to EVID-20260319-7800024680.
